title: Editorial Remediation Control Plane

evidence.claim: Checkpoint 0070 passed the complete cross-platform GitHub Actions workflow.
Adds deterministic read-only remediation classification and safety-bound operator actions.
Adds machine-readable remediation CLI over the existing consistency inspector.
Exposes civora-remediation as an installed operator command.
Covers no-action, exact-prepared recovery, committed divergence and mixed-report dominance.
Exercises real durable stores and CLI JSON/exit-code behavior across healthy, recoverable and fail-closed states.
Documents remediation policy, safety properties, gates, backlog, blockers and next action.

completed_gates: exact prepared transaction is the sole automatic recovery class
operator inspection guidance is identifier-bound and read-only
standalone remediation command exposed through package metadata
planner and CLI regression tests added
remaining_backlog: integrate remediation summary into primary civora health/editorial-consistency output without policy duplication
operator runbook examples for backup restore and evidence-preserving manual repair
production-readiness review across crash recovery, durable health, editorial safety, packaging, operations, security assumptions and release gates
blockers: Current-head cross-platform CI result required before CLOSED_VALIDATED.
next_action: If current-head CI passes, close 0071 and integrate the same remediation plan into unified health so monitoring receives actionable editorial-state guidance from the primary endpoint.
